#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
source "$1"
mode=$2
mount --make-rprivate /
mount -t tmpfs -o size=4M,nosuid,nodev tmpfs /run
mkdir /run/original-bin
mount --bind /usr/bin /run/original-bin
mount --bind /usr/bin /usr/bin
holder=
cleanup() { if [[ -n $holder ]]; then kill "$holder" 2>/dev/null || :; wait "$holder" 2>/dev/null || :; fi; }
trap cleanup EXIT
if [[ $mode != success ]]; then
    bash -c 'cd /usr/bin; : > /run/holder-ready; exec sleep 20' &
    holder=$!
    for ((i=0;i<100;i++)); do [[ ! -f /run/holder-ready ]] || break; sleep .01; done
    [[ -f /run/holder-ready ]]
fi
set +e
(
    set -e
    restore_needed=2
    trap logind_finish EXIT
    if [[ $mode == aborted ]]; then exit 124; fi
    logind_restore_executable_view
)
rc=$?
set -e
expected=0
[[ $mode != aborted ]] || expected=124
[[ $mode != strict_busy ]] || expected=32
[[ $rc == "$expected" ]]
if awk '$5=="/usr/bin" || $5=="/run/original-bin" {found=1} END {exit !found}' /proc/self/mountinfo; then
    echo 'FAIL owned mounts remain after EXIT'
    exit 1
fi
printf 'PASS real namespace mounts released mode=%s preserved_status=%s\n' "$mode" "$rc"
